analysis: Both units are head-side excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The PR only changes documentation: the date bump at line 3, a new free-space note for darkbloom sandbox setup (changed head range 1092-1106), edits at 1139-1156, and line 1217. The two supplied units begin at head line 1685 and 2115, so they show only unchanged surrounding text, not the changed hunks. I examined this surrounding text against the threat model. It describes model cache location, benchmark flags, update hash verification, the logout and unenroll lifecycle, report upload privacy, paths, the add-on runtime socket and the LaunchAgent environment passthrough. It adds no code, no new endpoints and no control changes. I found no statement that contradicts the existing T-041 prefix-cache posture (30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup names, KEK-wipe purge), the T-053 logout/revocation scope, or the TB-012/TB-013 add-on boundaries. Remaining uncertainty: the actual changed hunks for the sandbox setup disk-shortfall note and the lines near 1139-1156 are only partially visible in the patch excerpt, and that excerpt is truncated. The note appears to describe the CLI printing a computed disk figure (SandboxSizingPlan.freeSpaceNote) derived from the add-on's plan. That text is advisory and would only matter if the figure came from a hostile add-on, which is covered by T-061 and is not evidenced as new here. The Swift implementation was not supplied, so the behavior was not verified. No concrete security regression is identified from the supplied evidence.
